lessons: A zero-call observation is qualified only when actual entry callbacks, original source-site installation, live namespace and native target identity are independently checked. It does not prove the unexecuted domain effect happened.
Combine actual positive writes and foreign objects with normal-leader blank-queue control, preserve every writer-source scope and close only the stated finite case.
